title: Brand Terms
intro: These Brand Terms apply to companies that use Spektt as a brand ("Brand", "you"), on top of Spektt's general Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy. Spektt is operated by Axlume Tech Limited ("Spektt", "we", "us"), registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.
If these Brand Terms and the general Terms disagree on something about brand accounts or brand Showdowns, these Brand Terms apply.

sections.heading: 1. Who May Open a Brand Account
items: A brand account belongs to a company, organisation or business, not a person. It is opened by someone 18 or over who is authorised to act for that brand; by accepting these terms they accept them on the brand's behalf and confirm that authority.
A brand needs its own account. An existing creator account cannot become a brand account.

You must give accurate details: the brand's name, industry, website (the brand's own, starting https://), a work email at that website's domain (not Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook or another free email service) and the applicant's full name.
You must have the right to use the brand's name and logo. Pretending to be a brand you do not represent is impersonation: the account is removed and may be reported.

sections.heading: 2. Verification
items: We email a 6-digit code to your work email. Confirming it proves you can receive mail at the brand's domain.

We also check whether the brand name is close to a well-known brand and when the website's domain was registered. If the name is close to a well-known brand, or the domain is under 6 months old or its age cannot be confirmed, a person at Spektt reviews the application, usually within 2 business days. Otherwise the brand is verified as soon as the email is confirmed.

A verified brand shows a gold badge beside its name everywhere on Spektt. The badge means Spektt confirmed control of the brand's email domain; it is not an endorsement of the brand, its products or its claims.

If we reject an application we tell you why. You may fix it and apply again from the app (three applications per account in all), or appeal a rejection within 3 business days by email to safety@spektt.com.

Your website and work email are fixed once verified; moving to a new domain is a new verification (contact support@spektt.com). A new brand name is checked again, and a name close to a different well-known brand is refused.

sections.heading: 3. What a Brand Account Can and Cannot Do
paras: A verified brand can keep a public brand page (logo, name, industry, About, website), post work such as briefs and campaign material, follow creators and, once available (section 5), present Showdowns.

A brand account cannot enter or vote in Showdowns, create or join Clusters, earn XP, badges or a leaderboard place, buy Spektt Pro, or send direct messages. Contact between brands and creators will come through a separate inquiries feature with its own terms.
Until it is verified, a brand's page is visible only to the brand, and it cannot post, follow or appear in search.

sections.heading: 4. Your Page and Content
items: Everything on your page and in your posts must be accurate, lawful and follow the Community Guidelines. You are responsible for any advertising claims you make, including the advertising rules of your country.
You keep ownership of your logo and content. You let Spektt display them on Spektt and in Spektt's own promotion of your page or your Showdowns, for as long as your account exists.
You must not ask creators to pay you, move a Showdown conversation off Spektt or trade votes, nor contact entrants about a Showdown outside Spektt while it is running.

sections.heading: 5. Brand Showdowns (coming soon)
paras: Brand Showdowns are not open yet. When they open, these terms apply:
items: A verified brand can propose a Showdown: its name, brief, rules, judging criteria, dates and a cash prize pool split into first, second and third prizes. Prizes are cash only: no products, vouchers or services.

Spektt is the Sponsor of every Showdown under its Official Showdown Rules; the brand appears as its "Presented by" partner, with its name and logo linking to its page. Apple and Google are not sponsors and are not involved.
Brand Showdowns are open to entrants in Nigeria for now, stay open for submissions for at least 7 days, and start at least 3 days after they are submitted.
Pool limits: at least ₦100,000; up to ₦500,000 for a brand's first Showdown, and up to ₦1,000,000 after one completed Showdown. One brand Showdown in draft or running at a time.
Spektt's judges judge by the published criteria; the brand does not choose the winners. Results follow the Official Showdown Rules.
After payment, Spektt reviews the brief within 1 business day and may reject it with a reason (refund: section 8).
Entrants keep ownership of their work. Presenting a Showdown gives the brand no rights in any entry; any use of an entry must be agreed directly with its creator.

sections.heading: 6. Fees and Payment
items: You pay the prize pool plus Spektt's fee of 25% of the pool, charged on top: a ₦200,000 pool costs ₦250,000. The whole pool goes to the winners (less the withholding tax described in the Official Showdown Rules); the fee is Spektt's.

Payment is by bank transfer, through a secure payment link we email to your work email. Spektt never takes payment inside the app, and a Showdown is not reviewed or published until its payment is received.
Our payment processor, named in the Privacy Policy, handles the transfer; Spektt never sees your bank login. Any tax due on the fee is shown on your invoice.

sections.heading: 7. Prizes Nobody Claims
paras: A winner has 14 days to claim; an unclaimed prize passes to the next eligible entrant, at most twice. A prize still unclaimed becomes credit for your brand, usable on a future Showdown within 12 months. After 12 months, unused credit can be refunded on request; the fee is not refunded.

sections.heading: 8. Cancellations and Refunds
items: Too few entries (Premium Showdowns need 10): the submission window is extended once, by 7 days. If there are still too few, the Showdown closes, the pool becomes credit, and the fee carries over to a re-run within 12 months.
You withdraw after paying but before submissions open: the pool becomes credit; the fee is kept.
Spektt rejects or cancels the Showdown: the pool and the fee are refunded in full.
Once enough creators have entered, the brand cannot cancel the Showdown: creators have done the work.

sections.heading: 9. Paid to Creators
paras: Your page shows how much your Showdowns have paid winners in total (net of tax withheld) and how many Showdowns you have completed. Spektt calculates both from actual payouts; they cannot be edited.

sections.heading: 10. Suspension and Removal
paras: We may suspend or remove a brand account, its page or a Showdown that breaks these Brand Terms, the general Terms, the Community Guidelines or the law, or that we reasonably believe is impersonation or fraud.

sections.heading: 11. General
paras: Liability, indemnity, governing law and disputes are as in the general Terms (the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria). We may update these Brand Terms; we email material changes to your work email before they take effect.
Contact: support@spektt.com · Appeals: safety@spektt.com · Axlume Tech Limited, Federal Republic of Nigeria.
